events.what: 董事表示有意在闭门期交易
events.what_en: Director indicated intention to deal in closed period

recent_en: EIB recently saw director dealings during the closed period: Operational and Technical Director Tia Tuan Sim indicated on 10 Nov an intention to deal during the closed period and actually disposed of 254,000 shares on 12 Nov. In addition, the company's warrant EIB-WA will expire on 18 Dec 2026 with an exercise price of RM0.41.
notable_en: Operational and Technical Director Tia Tuan Sim disposed of 254,000 ordinary shares during the closed period.
EIB-WA warrants will expire on 18 Dec 2026 with an exercise price of RM0.41.
risks_en: Operational and Technical Director Tia Tuan Sim disposed of 254,000 shares during the closed period, representing about 0.068% of issued shares.
EIB-WA warrants will expire on 18 Dec 2026, and unexercised warrants will lapse.
